final:
Found and fixed all 3 errors. Grader score 1.000 (3/3 fixed, integrity 1.00).

1. **Revenue!F3**: Year 4 export revenue was a typed-in 30,060 instead of a formula. Changed to `=E3*(1+Inputs!$B$6)`.
2. **Revenue!E5**: Year 3 total summed only `E2:E3`, so it missed licensing. Changed to `=SUM(E2:E4)`.
3. **PnL!E2**: Year 3 revenue pulled domestic revenue only (`Revenue!E2`). Changed to total revenue, `=Revenue!E5`.

Inputs and all other formulas in PnL, CashFlow and DCF match the Notes, so I left them alone. Equity value per share went from $12.90 to $14.05.
